summaryBox.title: Quick Section Summary
summaryBox.takeaway: Human circulation is a closed double loop: Pulmonary (RV -> Lungs -> LA) and Systemic (LV -> Body -> RA). Hepatic portal system routes nutrients from gut to liver. Hypophyseal portal routes hormones to anterior pituitary.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
DOUBLE CIRCULATION LOOPS
                                       │
         ┌─────────────────────────────┴─────────────────────────────┐
         ▼                                                           ▼
   PULMONARY CIRCULATION                                      SYSTEMIC CIRCULATION
   Right Ventricle ──► Pulmonary Artery ──► Lungs             Left Ventricle ──► Main Aorta ──► Body Tissues
   Lungs ──► Pulmonary Veins ──► Left Atrium                  Tissues ──► Vena Cava ──► Right Atrium
conceptBreakdown.content:
Human circulation is a **Closed Double Circulation**, comprising two distinct loops that prevent any mixing of oxygenated and deoxygenated blood streams:

```
                        SPECIALIZED PORTAL SYSTEMS
                        
   1. HEPATIC PORTAL SYSTEM:
      Digestive Tract Capillaries ──► **Hepatic Portal Vein** ──► Liver Capillaries ──► Hepatic Vein
      (Reroutes absorbed nutrients to liver before systemic circulation).
      
   2. HYPOPHYSEAL PORTAL SYSTEM:
      Hypothalamus Capillaries ──► **Hypophyseal Portal Vein** ──► Anterior Pituitary (Adenohypophysis)
      (Transports hypothalamic releasing/inhibiting hormones directly to pituitary).
```
